Source: Stand at the platform edge to board
en: Stand at the platform edge to board
de: Zum Einsteigen an die Bahnsteigkante stellen

Source: When the lamps swing and a white glow grows behind you, climb into a wardrobe or trunk until it has passed.
en: When the lamps swing and a white glow grows behind you, climb into a wardrobe or trunk until it has passed.
de: Wenn die Lampen schwingen und hinter dir ein weißes Leuchten wächst: ab in einen Schrank oder Koffer, bis es vorbei ist.

Source: You have a few seconds. Remember where the nearest wardrobe is in every car.
en: You have a few seconds. Remember where the nearest wardrobe is in every car.
de: Du hast ein paar Sekunden. Merk dir in jedem Wagen, wo der nächste Schrank steht.

Source: Bright light at the windows on one side: cross to the other side of the car.
en: Bright light at the windows on one side: cross to the other side of the car.
de: Helles Licht an den Fenstern einer Seite: Wechsle auf die andere Wagenseite.

Source: The arrow on your screen shows where the light comes from. Move away from it.
en: The arrow on your screen shows where the light comes from. Move away from it.
de: Der Pfeil zeigt, von wo das Licht kommt. Geh auf die andere Seite.

Source: In dark cars, keep your distance from the green glow under seats and racks.
en: In dark cars, keep your distance from the green glow under seats and racks.
de: Halte in dunklen Wagen Abstand zu dem grünen Leuchten unter Sitzen und Ablagen.

Source: The glow gets brighter when you come close. Walk around it.
en: The glow gets brighter when you come close. Walk around it.
de: Das Leuchten wird heller, wenn du nahe kommst. Geh drumherum.

Source: When the inspector shows the striped paddle, stand still until the round paddle returns.
en: When the inspector shows the striped paddle, stand still until the round paddle returns.
de: Zeigt der Kontrolleur die Kelle mit dem Streifen, bleib stehen, bis die runde Kelle zurück ist.

Source: Walk to the inspector while the round paddle shows. Once your ticket is checked, you are safe.
en: Walk to the inspector while the round paddle shows. Once your ticket is checked, you are safe.
de: Geh zum Kontrolleur, solange die runde Kelle zu sehen ist. Wer kontrolliert ist, ist sicher.

Source: When the luggage starts to rumble behind you, run forward and do not stop.
en: When the luggage starts to rumble behind you, run forward and do not stop.
de: Wenn hinter dir das Gepäck rumpelt: nach vorn laufen und nicht stehen bleiben.

Source: Wardrobes will not help here. Once everyone is past the coupling, release it to leave the luggage behind.
en: Wardrobes will not help here. Once everyone is past the coupling, release it to leave the luggage behind.
de: Schränke helfen hier nicht. Sind alle an der Kupplung vorbei, löst sie, dann bleibt das Gepäck zurück.

Source: The conductor only sees what his lamp lights up and hears footsteps. Sneak and stay out of the beam.
en: The conductor only sees what his lamp lights up and hears footsteps. Sneak and stay out of the beam.
de: Der Schaffner sieht nur, was seine Lampe beleuchtet, und hört Schritte. Schleiche und bleib aus dem Lichtkegel.

Source: Read all three ticket scraps, then punch the full pattern at the validator. Wrong patterns are loud.
en: Read all three ticket scraps, then punch the full pattern at the validator. Wrong patterns are loud.
de: Lies alle drei Fahrkartenschnipsel und stanze dann das ganze Muster am Entwerter. Falsche Muster sind laut.
